Name: Love 'n' Friend Crops
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[i][b]Dear Farmers,

Are you tired of keeping all those gifts in mind for your beloved and friends? Don't you wish there was an easier way?
One that let's you focus on making the biggest bee farm ever, while still being able to romance your beloved villager?

Fret no longer! Pierre's Shop is now introducing the Love Shrub and the Friend Shrub! Those little plants give you everything you need to make worrying about gift tastes a thing of the past.
[/b][/i]
[size=6][center]
CROP INFO[/center][/size][b][size=4]❤️ Love Shrub ❤️[/size][/b]
Produces a Love Berry that can be gifted to any marriage candidate  from the base game, SVE and RSV
The Seeds are available at Pierre's for 1000g 
The shrub takes a whole season to grow, but produces once a week all year (including winter)


[b][size=4][url=https://emojipedia.org/star/]⭐[/url]Friend Shrub [url=https://emojipedia.org/star/]⭐[/url][/size][/b]
Produces a Friend Berry that can be gifted to any non-marriage candidate and roommate from the base game, SVE and RSV
The Seeds are available at Pierre's for 1000g 
The shrub takes a whole season to grow, but produces once a week all year (including winter)



[size=4]How to add additional marriage candidates & friends

[/size]1. Open the folder [JA] Love'n'Friend Crops 
2. Open the folder Objects > Open either Friendberry or Loveberry folder
3. Open the object.json (with Wordpad for example)
4. Under "Love" add the new villager to the list of the other villagers like this:  "Name"
(You can also take villagers out of the list this way)
